title: Constraint assignment on its scope
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set of variables, and let $c$ be a three-literal satisfiability constraint whose scope is an ordered triple of distinct variables. For any Boolean assignment $a:V\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, the first component of the assignment split into its values on the scope and its values off the scope is the function on the three scope positions given by $i\mapsto a(c_i)$.
hypotheses_covered: c is a three-literal satisfiability constraint on V with an ordered scope of three distinct variables
a is a Boolean assignment on V
